title: feat(news): write each month's contributor counts in the monthly job
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The monthly news job now writes `monthly/<month>/contributors.json` for the website’s community section, including when a month has no other posts to write. Starting with finished months from 2026-11-01, it counts each PR merged into `main` or `master` once and credits its author and noreply co-authors by GitHub account ID. The job receives a GitHub token for search. Recounts matched the existing backfills for 2026-09 (691 PRs, 75 accounts) and 2025-06 (73 PRs, 8 accounts), apart from one avatar link that changed after the backfill.
